briefing.headline: Drive as far as you can. Hold W to go, S to brake (hold S at rest to reverse), A/D to steer. Don't hit the barriers.

tidbits.mud: Friction pushes against you. In mud it can beat your motor, and then you slow down.
tidbits.sand: Sand's friction is lower than your motor's force, so at top speed you hold your speed.
tidbits.ice: Ice has very little friction and very little grip.
tidbits.boost: An impulse changes momentum: Δv = J ÷ m. Lighter rovers gain more.
tidbits.headOnHit: You hand part of your momentum to the bag. The total stays the same, so you slow down.
tidbits.kickerHit: The bag from behind hands you some of its momentum. The total stays the same, so you speed up.
tidbits.gravity: Gravity presses you into the ground, so friction grows with it. Your mass stays the same; your weight changes.
tidbits.slip: Your motor or your brake pushes harder than the tyres can grip.
tidbits.aboveTopSpeed: Nothing pushes you now. Only friction slows you: Newton's first law.
tidbits.slide: Tyres can only bend your path so fast, and the faster you go the slower that is. Steer harder than the tyres allow and you slide.

formulas.mud: Friction = mud's friction × your wheels' rolling × mass × g
formulas.headOnHit: Momentum before = momentum after: m₁u₁ + m₂u₂ = (m₁ + m₂)v
formulas.kickerHit: Momentum before = momentum after: m₁u₁ + m₂u₂ = (m₁ + m₂)v

tryThis.pickLane: Pick a lane before the tunnel: the divider is solid.
tryThis.stuckInHighGravity: Try the low-gravity tunnel: less weight means less friction.
tryThis.smoothWheels: Try Smooth wheels: they lose less speed in mud.
tryThis.brakeFirst: Brake before the cannon's line: a slower rover loses less speed to a sandbag.
tryThis.heavyChassis: Try the Heavy chassis: a heavier rover loses less speed to a sandbag.
tryThis.dodgeCannon: Dodge the cannon's line: the sandbags cost you the most speed.
tryThis.brakeBeforeCorner: Brake before the corner: a slower rover slides less.
tryThis.takeBoosts: Take the boost pads: each one adds speed.
